newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian shares close slightly higher.
newsitem.headline: Italian shares close slightly higher.

text.p: 1530 GMT - Italian shares closed mostly higher with gains by blue chip industrials Fiat and ENI outweighing losses by banks and insurance stocks and by the heavily-traded Olivetti.
* The all-share mibtel index ended 0.51 percent higher at 9,637 while the blue chip mib30 index ended 0.75 percent up at 14,477.
* Shares in Telecom Italia Mobile rose 2.07 percent to 3,053 lire when first half results came in a touch better than analysts' expectations.

* Olivetti shares tumbled 4.76 percent to close at 540.6 lire after Thursday's sharp rebound ran out of steam. Volumes continued to stay unusually high with more than 80 million shares changing hands.

* Brokers said that a foreign institutional investor appeared to unwinding its position in the company. Several foreign investors, including Nomura's fund management arm, have liquidated their stake in Olivetti in recent days.
* Brokers have also speculated that one or more buyers could be building up a stake in the company.
* Fiat closed 1.38 percent higher at 4,247 lire but below the highs as the market digested better than expected first-half results.

* Brokers said that ENI's share price was supported by firm oil prices and by signs that investors not involved in the forthcoming placement of a second tranche of shares were building up positions in the hope that it would go well.
* Volumes were swollen by the expiry of options and derivative contracts. Milan newsroom +392-66102321
